newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce shares in $290 mln engine deal.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce shares in $290 mln engine deal.

text.p: Rolls-Royce Plc said it had won business worth nearly $100 million as part of a $290 million order for International Aero Engines V2500 engines from several airlines.
The orders were received from: International Lease Finance Corporation (ILFC), EgyptAir, Heliopolis Airlines and Kibris Turk Hava Yollari.
ILFC has selected IAE to power seven A319, A320 and A321 family airliners.
Egyptair ordered V2500 engines to power its new fleet of A321s, Rolls-Royce said. Four A321s will be delivered and all will be in service by the end of next year.
Heliopolis Airlines, a new Egyptian airline, has picked the V2500 to power the MD-90, for which it placed one firm order and taking options on two more.
The Kibris order is for three firm MD-90s and options on a further three. The first two aircraft will be delivered in December.
